title: Full-length tender and two quotations
description: A 42-line tender with 15 required items, a quotation in positioned columns and a quotation written as prose, each sent in 4 parts. Recorded output of the selected model on these fictional documents (validation batch SC-T12, 1 November 2026): 12 of 12 pre-registered findings, no false critical findings. Some extraction faults are kept as recorded (item values without their code, a wrong quantity, missed and held prices).

blocks.text: Tender TN-7731: Supply of laboratory and field instruments (fictional sample)
Issued by the Ridgeback Catchment Authority, a fictional public body.
Tenders close on 12 January 2027. All amounts are in South African rand.
Tenderers must price each line separately and keep to the order of the table below.
Notes for tenderers
Read all parts of this tender before preparing an offer.
Site visits can be arranged through the procurement office on written request.
Goods are delivered to the authority store at Ridgeback and signed for on arrival.
Each package must carry a label showing the line reference and the tender number.
Instruments must be supplied calibrated, with a certificate where one applies.
Operating manuals in English must accompany each instrument.
Substitutes are accepted only when stated clearly and priced apart from the main offer.
The authority may ask for a working sample before it makes an award.
Questions about this tender are answered in writing to every tenderer together.
Nothing in this tender commits the authority to buy any item shown.
Required goods
Ref Description Qty Requirement
LB-3101 Digital pH meter 6 each 0.01 pH resolution
LB-3102 Turbidity meter 4 each 0-1000 NTU, battery powered
LB-3110 Magnetic stirrer 8 each hotplate, up to 300 C
LB-3115 Analytical balance with 2 each 220 g, 0.1 mg readability
draught shield
FD-4201 Water level logger 20 each 10 m range, vented cable
FD-4202 Flow velocity probe 5 each 0.1-5 m/s, IP68
FD-4210 Rain gauge 12 each tipping bucket, 0.2 mm
FD-4215 Soil moisture sensor with 30 each capacitance type, 3 m cable
datalogger interface
SP-5301 Sample bottle 500 ml 400 each HDPE, wide neck
SP-5302 Sample bottle 1 l 200 each amber glass
SP-5310 Cool box 45 l 10 each insulated, 48 hour hold
CL-6401 Calibration standard set 15 sets pH 4, 7 and 10, 250 ml
Conditions of tender
Offers stay open for ninety days after the closing date.
Prices are firm until delivery and are quoted without VAT.
A tenderer must say plainly what its price leaves out.
Delivery is expected within six weeks of a written order.
The authority may place its order with more than one tenderer.
Late offers are returned without being read.
Payment follows thirty days after a correct invoice is received.
The authority does not have to accept the lowest offer or any offer.
This document and everything in it is invented for software testing only.
No real company, product or price is meant by any figure shown here.
